# Milestone brief — source-truth-m5

**Title:** get_chunk surfaces source-truth fields (rides W1)
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** source-truth (plans/source-truth/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-08-31 -> 2026-09-11

## Parent epic

- source-truth-e2 — Chunk-level source truth: spans, truncation, printed numbers
  Chunks-schema v2 rides ingest/store.py::_migrate_chunks_schema_if_needed with five columns (source_revision_id, source_span, truncated, printed_number, license_ref), the printed-number extractor, span anchoring computed from the existing parsed HTML (null-plus-reported fallback, no re-parse), and zero-re-embed backfill per the tools/notebook_metadata_backfill.py precedent. Vertical to the serving surface: get_chunk responses carry revision id, span-or-null, truncation status, and printed number, with field surfacing batched into agent-platform's W1 tool-schema window.

## Summary

get_chunk responses carry source revision id, span-or-null (explicit null, not omission), truncation status, printed number, and the per-revision license decision (advisory until the e4 cutover). The response-shape delta batches into agent-platform's W1 tool-schema re-pin window; if W1 never materializes, the documented fallback is a standalone TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION re-pin.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given any chunk in a hydrated notebook, when get_chunk is called, then the response carries source revision id, source span or an explicit null, truncation status, printed number, and a per-revision license decision
2. Given the implemented response fields, when the schema delta is staged, then it ships inside agent-platform's W1 bundled TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION re-pin, or as a documented standalone re-pin only if W1 never materializes

## Depends on

- source-truth-m2 — Chunks schema v2: spans, truncation, printed numbers persisted [status: planned]
